product.olivetti-m4-62.summary: The 33 MHz SX M4 in the 305 Box chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-62.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. In February 1994, MCmicrocomputer tested the M4-62 and listed it at 3,000,000 lire before VAT with a colour monitor.
product.olivetti-m4-62.architecture: Memory can grow without replacing the base RAM. The board has 4 MB soldered down, one SIMM socket and CL-GD5428 graphics.
product.olivetti-m4-62.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-62.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-62.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-62.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 2.06.
